author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸ್ನಿಗ್ಧ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯವೆನೆ ಸರ್ವಾಂಗ ಸುಂದರವು
ಮುಗ್ಧತೆಯು ಜತೆಗೂಡೆ ಅದ್ಭುತದ ಮೆರುಗು
ದಗ್ಧವಾಗಿರೆ ನಿನ್ನ ಕಶ್ಮಲವು ಕೋರೆಗಳು
ದುಗ್ಧದಂತೆಯೆ ನೀನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Gentle beauty makes every limb lovely;
joined with innocence, it has a wondrous sheen;
when your impurities and sharp edges are burnt away,
you are like pure milk, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: True beauty is gentleness joined with innocence. Burn away impurities and harshness, and you become as pure as milk.
